description: Coach tool-use eval. Each case is one user message; the model's first response must call expected_tool with arguments matching expected_args (numbers equal, strings contained, case-insensitive). expected_tool null means no action may be proposed (the model should answer or ask). read_ok lists read tools that are acceptable instead of or before the expected one.
